overview.title: Welcome to Monthloom
overview.body: Take a quick tour of your household finance workspace.

household.title: Create your household
household.body: Households let members plan and track finances together.

add-transaction.title: Add a transaction
add-transaction.body: Record income or expenses for the selected month.

transaction-kind.title: Choose income or expense
transaction-kind.body: Start by selecting the kind of transaction.

transaction-source.title: Choose or add a source
transaction-source.body: Sources keep entries from the same shop, employer or provider consistent.

transaction-fields.title: Complete the transaction
transaction-fields.body: Set its type, owner, amount, date and appearance.

recurring.title: Repeat an entry
recurring.body: Turn on recurrence for regular income or expenses.

expiration.title: Set an end date
expiration.body: Recurring entries can continue indefinitely or expire on a date.

months.title: Move between months
months.body: Review the plan for any month and return to the current month quickly.

settings-menu.title: Open settings
settings-menu.body: Manage your profile, households, sources and appearance here.

household-invitations.title: Invite household members
household-invitations.body: Share a link or email an invitation to plan together.

home.title: Return home
home.body: Use the home button whenever you want to return to the dashboard.
